summary: Police say the body of a 24-year-old man with a gunshot wound to the head was found near a dam on a farm between Overhex, Worcester, and MaGwaleni, Zwelethemba, on the morning of Wednesday 14 October. Worcester police re...
story: Police say the body of a 24-year-old man with a gunshot wound to the head was found near a dam on a farm between Overhex, Worcester, and MaGwaleni, Zwelethemba, on the morning of Wednesday 14 October. Worcester police registered a murder case; spokesperson Lt-Col F.C. van Wyk said the motive is part of the investigation (Worcester Standard). One source only, and it does not say when he died.
